The excerpt is truncated, so the full diff was not visible. - The MLX submodule pin change (mlx-swift and mlx) is not visible as source. The submodule diff and the kernel argument fix are outside the supplied evidence. This touches TB-007 (inference engine) and the supply chain behind T-013/T-034 (signed artifact and binary hash). The next review pass should confirm that the pin bump is the stated minimal fix and that the release is registered and qualified through the normal signed-artifact path.
- The doc notes that the crash loop can trip the KV-backend guard and that the watchdog auto-update installs 0.10.3. This relates to T-043 (watchdog rollback/update authority). It is described as existing behavior, not a new change.
- The changelog entries in the viewed range are historical and describe the encrypted SSD cache (T-041), the 30-minute TTL and the like. Nothing visible alters those controls.

No regressions or threat-model invalidations are identified in the supplied units. Residual uncertainty: the submodule pin contents and the truncated changelog head are not reviewable here.
